conference_ties: Projection model: winning percentage, ACC alternate-game ties, head-to-head, common opponents, opponent conference winning percentage, then a uniform lottery. This is not a complete reproduction of each league's official tiebreaker book.
ranking_model: Final simulated Elo, random ordering for exactly tied ratings. Elo substitutes for committee judgment.
eligibility: All source-classified 2026 FBS teams; no postseason bans are asserted by this model.
